message.content: {"caption":"Three-panel scatter chart comparing latency and accuracy for three inference pipelines.","description":"The target is a three-panel scatter chart. Each panel plots Accuracy (%) vertically against Latency (s) horizontally on a logarithmic scale, with ticks including 10⁰, 10¹, and 10². The panels are F1 (↑), B1 (↑), and J (↑). The legend identifies Base in blue, Base + Reranker in orange, and Memory-R1 (GRPO) in green; circles denote p50 and triangles denote p95. Approximate read-offs show that Memory-R1 has the highest accuracy and lowest latency in all three panels: about 45.5% F1, 37.7% B1, and 62.3% J, with its p50 and p95 marks close together at low latency. Base has the lowest accuracy—about 30.5% F1, 22.3% B1, and 45.8% J—and its p95 latency is much higher than its p50. Base + Reranker is intermediate in F1 and B1 (about 32.5% and 24.7%) and reaches about 60% J; its latency marks are also well to the right of Memory-R1’s.
